c1.note: Q2 FY27 results and call were September 2, 2026; Q3 call is scheduled for Dec 2, so Q2 is the latest.

c10.note: Robins said Q2 benefited from core data platform strength and a meaningful step-up in AI revenue.

c17.note: Management said AI brings new workloads and the flywheel is accelerating, with product revenue growth accelerating for a third straight quarter.

c18.note: Robins said adopters of CoCo and CoWork also increase business within the core, and management called the effect a flywheel.

c21.note: Robins made the remarks on CoCo and CoWork adopters increasing core business.

c22.note: Ramaswamy said AI products contributed about half of the acceleration, with core products and faster migrations supplying the rest.

c24.note: Ramaswamy said growth came from a broad customer base and AI-native companies remain a small part of revenue.

c27.note: Robins said guidance is based on observed behavior up until the call.

c29.note: The press release gives FY27 product revenue guidance of $6,070M, 36% growth.

c31.note: Release says the new $6,070M guide is up from the previous $5,840M, or 31% growth.

c32.note: Q3 guide of $1,588M-$1,593M, or 37-38% growth, is confirmed by the release and the call transcript. The Q3 report is not yet out as of today, so this is the latest guidance.

c33.note: NRR of 126% is in the release and the call.

c35.note: CoCo passed 9,100 accounts, and CoWork is at 5,800, per the release.

c36.note: The release states more than 2,000 CoCo accounts were added in the quarter, and CoWork reached 5,800.

c37.note: 692 net new customers, up 32% year over year, is confirmed.

c38.note: 828 customers above $1M (up 27%) and 829 Forbes Global 2000 customers are confirmed.

c39.note: The margin guide rose from 13.5% to 14.5%. It is a margin item rather than a consumption item.

c40.note: The CFO tied the 74% gross margin guide to a higher mix of AI workloads.

c42.note: The call says growth exited Q4 at 30% and added 7 points of acceleration in two quarters to 37%.

c43.note: Shares rose 22.37% after hours, per Investing.com.

c44.note: The CFO's call remarks say customers favor Q4 renewals, so bookings will be increasingly weighted to Q4.

c45.note: Total revenue of $1.55B, up 35%, is confirmed.

c20.note: The CFO said on the Q2 FY27 call: "Consumption of CoWork is scaling and driving revenue contribution alongside a diverse set of AI tools." Text confirmed in the stockanalysis.com copy of the transcript. The Q2 call is the latest, since Q3 hasn't been reported as of 2026-11-10.

c26.note: CEO Ramaswamy: "At this time, we are not ready to share the exact uplift numbers, but we do measure cohort behavior." Both variants A and F match. The Motley Fool transcript says the same.

c12.note: Q2 FY27 is the latest call (Sept 2, 2026; Q3 results are due Dec 2). In the press release Ramaswamy said AI is 'creating a flywheel effect across the business' and that CoWork and CoCo are 'driving transformational outcomes.' On the call he said the flywheel strengthens platform demand through AI ad

c28.note: Per the Q2 FY27 call transcript, CFO Robins said: 'As always, our forecast is based on observed consumption patterns. There are no changes to our forecast methodology or our guidance philosophy.'

c30.note: The Q2 FY27 release raised FY27 product revenue guidance to $6,070M, up from the prior $5,840M (31% growth). The $5.84B figure was set at Q1. This is context for the consumption question rather than a direct answer.
